## Testing Mode: GREEN

Create plugins/dso/scripts/mode-detect.sh — reads enforcement.strategy and merge.strategy from dso-config.conf, checks git remote get-url origin, prints exactly 'ci-pr' or 'local' to stdout.

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies DD3: Unit tests written and passing (T1 RED test passes GREEN after this task).

## Logic

1. Read enforcement.strategy from $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.claude/dso-config.conf
2. Read merge.strategy from same config
3. Run: git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null
4. If enforcement.strategy=ci AND merge.strategy=pr AND remote URL is non-empty: print 'ci-pr'
5. Otherwise: print 'local'
6. Exit 0 in all cases

## File Impact

### Files to Create
- plugins/dso/scripts/mode-detect.sh

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Script exists at plugins/dso/scripts/mode-detect.sh and is executable (chmod +x immediately)
- [ ] Script prints exactly 'ci-pr' when enforcement.strategy=ci AND merge.strategy=pr AND remote non-empty
- [ ] Script prints exactly 'local' when any condition fails
- [ ] Script uses set -euo pipefail
- [ ] Script uses REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) for config path
- [ ] Script exits 0 in all cases (mode detection is never fatal)
- [ ] T1 RED test passes GREEN (PASSED: 4  FAILED: 0, exit 0)
- [ ] ShellCheck passes with no errors
- [ ] .test-index entry already registered (done by T1)

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
